title: Clock hand angle at 3:15 (hard)
prompt: A clock shows 3:15. What is the angle between the hour and minute hands? Explain your reasoning.

metadata.hard_reason: Classic gotcha: naive answers assume the hour hand is still exactly at the 3, missing that it has moved 1/4 of the way toward 4 by 15 minutes past the hour.
metadata.notes: Hour hand at 3:15 is at 90 + (15/60)*30 = 97.5 degrees from 12; minute hand at 15 minutes is at 90 degrees from 12; difference = 7.5 degrees.
